messages:
matt: deploy-bot just flagged an autorevert candidate for the hosted text-gen route. noisy p95 spike but signal is a bit ambiguous. requesting ops triage and decision (auto revert vs human hold). :eyes:

deploy-bot: AUTO-REVERT ALERT
severity: medium
metric: route=hosted-text-gen p95 +230ms (baseline 120ms)
error_rate +0.3% (baseline 0.05%)
trigger: rolling-kanary-thresholds
action_suggested: autorevert -> v1.7.3
note: signal windows=3m, smoothing=2

lucy: looks borderline. error rate not huge but p95 jump is real. i'd prefer human-in-the-loop here, do a partial traffic tilt back to previous model and suppress autorevert for 15m while we validate. :thumbsup:

ops_oncall: what exact criteria do we want to use to escalate to full revert? who signs off the suppression?

elaine: propose this rule: if p95 > +200ms AND error_rate > +0.2% for 10 continuous minutes -> full revert. otherwise, allow a 20% traffic tilt for 15 minutes and monitor. ops oncall (you) can authorize suppression; engineer oncall can execute the tilt. quick commands below: 
```
# pin previous model (fast mitigation)
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.dev/v1/releases/pin 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"route":"hosted-text-gen","target_version":"v1.7.3"}'

# partial traffic split (20% back to pinned)
redwood rollout split --route hosted-text-gen --from v1.8.0 --to v1.7.3 --percent 20
```

jordan: i'll draft a short release-note addendum / incident blurb just in case we revert. also pinging CS for heads-up if we tilt traffic. i'll post draft in ~5m.

matt: i'm going to pin v1.7.3 now and suppress autorevert while we observe. will execute partial split if ops confirms.

matt: `curl .../pin` -> 200 OK, release.pinned:true, pinned_by:matt :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: AutoRevert suppressed by manual_override (actor=matt) until 6024682317 (15m). Autorevert disabled for route=hosted-text-gen. Monitoring continues.

ops_oncall: suppressing autorevert authorized. @matt please run the 20% tilt. if p95 stays >+200ms for 10m, we do a full revert. if errors exceed +0.5% notify SRE immediately.

lucy: running the split now: `redwood rollout split --route hosted-text-gen --from v1.8.0 --to v1.7.3 --percent 20` -> started. :spinner: quick sanity checks: tailing logs for 2m.

matt: split applied, traffic tilt at 20% complete. :white_check_mark: metrics will update in ~1m.

jordan: draft for release notes / cs: "We observed transient latency increase on hosted text-gen after today's rollout. We have temporarily routed 20% of traffic to the previous model v1.7.3 while we validate. No customer-facing errors observed. We'll update if we revert fully." please review.

elaine: LGTM. i'll notify CS and add to the incident tracker (internal). tagging @ops_oncall to confirm next steps.

ops_oncall: confirmed. set watches on p95 and errors, leave autorevert suppressed. if thresholds cross (p95>+200ms & errors>0.2%) for 10m, proceed to full revert and update release notes to indicate rollback. otherwise we re-open traffic after 15m and remove pin.

matt: got it. i'll monitor and post updates here every 5m.

lucy: initial 3m after tilt: p95 delta down to +110ms, error_rate steady at 0.12%. looks like partial tilt helped. :relieved:

jordan: preparing customer note to send if we end up reverting. holding until we see 15m window.

ops_oncall: final: leaving this thread open for the window. manual override in place. if everything stays stable we'll unpin and resume full rollout at 6034681420.

matt: thanks team — keeping eyes on it. :coffee:
